Market today: The S&P 500 just hit a new high, but there's a strong undercurrent of caution with Michael Burry warning of a potential 1987-style crash. Uber's weak forecast adds to concerns for tech/growth names.

Your holdings: SOXL (-45.03%) and SPAL (-47.87%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning their deep drawdowns are amplified, especially on margin. SMH (-9.53%) is also down, but less severely.

Watch: Keep a close eye on overall market sentiment, particularly how tech reacts to any further signs of economic slowdown or market volatility. Also, monitor your leveraged positions closely.

Bottom line: With margin and leveraged ETFs, risk management is paramount, especially when market sentiment is so divided.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming this leveraged ETF. Its -45.03% drawdown is significant and amplified by margin.
SPAL: Review your position in this new, highly volatile leveraged ETF. Its -47.87% loss is a major concern.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market signals are too mixed for new speculative positions.
